role_reviews.summary: Qualifier schema identified: examples need accepted evidence_kind, coefficient_bearing=true, empty blockers, and a passing comparison_summary.
AMFlow semantics identified: D0 computes around D=D0-2eps; AMFMode selects eta insertion; EndingScheme selects terminal boundary systems.
Approved the final partial-blocked interpretation: amflow-cli solve-series runs non-interactively, but exposes only --eps-order, --digits, and --out; no CLI flags for D0, AMFMode, or EndingScheme.
Anti-fake-parity review verified the 7/3 and 4 values, comparison summary, defaults, and retained failure errors trace to the recorded amflow-cli output files.
